en: :w[叫] means "is called," so a name comes next: :ex[我叫王明。] :w[是] can take a name too, and it also says what someone is: :ex[我是老师。]
A tone is the pitch shape of a syllable. The 1st stays high and level. The 2nd rises. The 3rd is low. The 4th falls from the top.
